Chapter 6503: Bury Everyone

Chapter 6503: Bury Everyone

“Boom!” Trinity and Immortal Gate followed suit and obeyed the call of their primal ancestors.

Three massive shadows appeared in Trinity - the grand momentum combined with the vitality and power of its disciples. An immortal pulse could be seen soaring from Immortal Gate to the proper user.

“Everlasting Immortal!” Everything gathered within Seventy-two Origin Ancestor.

“For you!” The everlasting spirit and Lord of Paragon shouted.

ƒrēe.com

A maelstrom formed and took over the process. The individuals no longer had agency over the flow of powers.

“Creak.” Enough power poured into the tube to reveal the opening. The light from the flame blinded everyone.

The land below turned into lava instantly. Fortunately, this was a forsaken desert or Old World would have suffered devastating damage.

Ocean-gaze and his allies turned pale upon seeing the flame of the immortal level. All of Old World combined couldn’t have produced this level of destruction.

Seventy-two’s body started cracking again, unable to handle holding the tube.

“Shit!” Skyraiser shouted.

The true might of the two realms mattered not since the vessel couldn’t handle it. Once he broke down, the tube would close again.

“We must do this! Even if it means death!” Seventy-two persuaded his wavering allies.

“Open!” He roared and jumped into the maelstrom, forcefully increasing the rotation.

“What are you doing?!” The others were pulled by the maelstrom.

“Give me all of your vitality!” Seventy-two’s anima and true fate exploded as he fused into the maelstrom.

It became bloody like the jaws of a ravenous beast.

“Rumble!” It forcefully drained the members of Seventy-two Skyraiser, Trinity, and Immortal Gate.

The empowering process turned into an all-out devourment.

“Ahh!” Disciples turned into dried corpses immediately. Worldly energy and the grand momentum of the three sects depleted at a rapid rate.

“No!” Bronze Ancestor returned from Sea of Heavenly Sin and tried to enter Seventy-two Skyraiser to shut the momentum down. However, the overwhelming force repelled him.

“He wants to drain all three dao lineages to strengthen his body.” North Kun God turned pale.

“Have you gone mad?!” Skyraiser and the others tried to stop the channels.

Unfortunately, the red maelstrom only obeyed Seventy-two and started devouring the primal ancestors as well.

“You will bury everyone, stop, abandon now!” Skyraiser shouted.

“Deserters deserve death.” Seventy-two used the maelstrom to crush Skyraiser into blood.

“!!!” Trinity, Nine-turns, and Eight-armed’s courage was shattered after seeing this. Even Skyraiser, his most loyal friend, wasn’t spared.

They immediately regretted this outcome. If they had fought normally, they would have just died at the hands of Li Qiye. Now, their sects were buried as well.

“If we die, we die together, no one is leaving!” Seventy-two shouted and aimed the maelstrom at them.

“Motherfucker!” The three couldn’t help but curse before being turned into blood and devoured by Seventy-two.
